_comment: Your own spawn rules, added on top of the built-in AntiNuke list. The built-in list applies whenever ExtendedProtection is on in server.json, so deleting this file does not turn protection off. Reloaded automatically when saved.
_barcodes: Exact barcodes to refuse, in addition to the built-in list.
_keywords: Matched anywhere in a barcode, case-insensitively. Keep these specific: a short or common word will block innocent items.
_whitelist: Allowed even when a built-in rule or a rule above would block them. Does not override Fusion's community list.
_spawnExempt: Anyone may spawn these whatever the Spawning rank says, for what the game spawns during normal play. Matched anywhere in a barcode, case-insensitively. Add a gun mod's magazine here when its name is not caught by the defaults.
_operatorOnly: Only Operator and above may spawn these.
_extended: Used when ExtendedProtection is on. Omit a value to take the built-in default.
